name: shorts-factory
description: 쇼핑쇼츠 팩토리 — 해외영상 짜집기 + 제품정보리뷰 로컬 웹앱

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,ui -c blue,green "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
